content: Go stdio child-process test idiom (stdlib exec_test.go pattern): test binary re-executes itself with env var (GO_WANT_HELPER_PROCESS=1) + TestMain dispatch to run a fake server on os.Stdin/os.Stdout, parent wires cmd.StdinPipe/StdoutPipe; golden files in testdata/*.golden updated with a -update flag for protocol output comparisons; alternative in-process fake = run server goroutine over net.Pipe or io.Pipe. golang/go issue #79941 proposes first-class testing API for child-process tests.
